item.title: Neighbors question QTS plan for Augusta’s first data center
item.description: About 200 people packed a public meeting Wednesday to question the impact and handling of what would be Augusta’s first commercial data center. The post Neighbors question QTS plan for Augusta’s first data center appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Anonymous video sparked probe that led to AU women’s golf coach’s firing
item.description: Augusta University terminated women’s golf head coach Ember Holloway in October 2025 after an internal investigation began with an anonymously submitted video and concluded she violated the university’s Amorous Relationships policy, according to human resources records. The post Anonymous video sparked probe that led to AU women’s golf coach’s firing appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County school bus involved in wreck Thursday morning
item.description: A Columbia County School District school bus was involved in a wreck around 7:30 a.m. on Thursday at the intersection of Columbia Road and William Few Parkway. The post Columbia County school bus involved in wreck Thursday morning appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta man pleads guilty in S.C. trooper shooting
item.description: Derrick Gathers, 40, of Augusta, has pleaded guilty to possessing a firearm after shooting a trooper with the S.C. Highway Patrol in the face. The post Augusta man pleads guilty in S.C. trooper shooting appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta man forces stepdaughter to plank & beats her for bad grades, cops say
item.description: For making bad grades, an Augusta girl was forced to get into the plank position over several days and then beaten for performing the exercise wrong, authorities said. The post Augusta man forces stepdaughter to plank & beats her for bad grades, cops say appeared first on The Augusta Press.
